title: UAAP: Sierba torches NU, powers UST to 13th straight win
summary: Karylle Sierba recorded a new career-high to power University of Santo Tomas past National University, 92-80, in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum.
